findings.passage: I’d focus on legislation that makes our elections secure, simple, and fair—without making it harder for anyone to vote.
findings.note: Opening line of his answer to the Ballotpedia survey question 'What legislation would you enact related to election administration in the United States?' (survey completed in 2025). The list that follows has no photo-ID or proof-of-citizenship item.

findings.passage: Outlaw tactics that target specific communities with long lines, reduced polling places, or confusing ID rules.
findings.note: One item under 'End Voter Suppression & Protect Access' in the same survey answer. It mentions ID rules only as a tactic to outlaw when confusing and aimed at specific communities. No position on photo ID or citizenship proof is stated.

findings.passage: Ban deliberate voter roll purges without notice and due process.
findings.note: Another item under the same heading in the same survey answer.

findings.passage: No‑excuse vote‑by‑mail available to every voter.
findings.note: Item under 'National Voting Standards' in the same survey answer. It does not mention ID for mail ballots.
